question: What were Texas Roadhouse's trailing-twelve-month total revenue and income-from-operations margin as of the end of its fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026)?
grading: Computation: TTM = FY2025 + 26 weeks 2026 - 26 weeks 2025. TTM total revenue USD 6,231.5M (6,231,515K); TTM income from operations USD 482.8M (482,795K); margin 7.75% (+/-0.2pp). Accept +/-0.5% on dollar figures. Fail if the window is not the 52 weeks ended June 30, 2026 or if net income is substituted.
answer: TTM total revenue = 5,878,075 (FY2025) + 3,313,142 (26 weeks to June 30, 2026) - 2,959,702 (26 weeks to July 1, 2025) = USD 6,231,515 thousand (USD 6,231.5 million). TTM income from operations = 474,740 + 289,129 - 281,074 = USD 482,795 thousand (USD 482.8 million). TTM operating margin = 482,795 / 6,231,515 = 7.75% [H13-E1][H13-E2].
